relationships.subject: varicella-zoster virus
relationships.evidence_quote: VZV-induced injury and danger signals activate ROS-related inflammatory pathways and the NLRP3 inflammasome, promoting the release of IL-1β, IL-18, TNF-α, and IL-6

relationships.subject: varicella-zoster virus
relationships.evidence_quote: VZV replication within the DRG activates neuroinflammatory cascades and upregulates neuronal injury markers, including ATF-3, Nav1.8, and neuropeptide Y (NPY)

key_findings: Review frames PHN as a neuroimmune disorder with peripheral (DRG, NLRP3 inflammasome, cytokines) and central sensitization components
Proposes stage-specific, mechanism-oriented therapy including NLRP3 inhibition, gene and RNA-based approaches
